changelog:
Initial release of the Gate Exchange Assets skill for multi-account asset and balance queries.

- Provides read-only access to aggregate and per-account asset balances across spot, margin, futures, options, unified, TradFi, and finance accounts.
- Supports total asset overview, coin-specific queries, and detailed sub-account breakdown via mapped MCP tools.
- Requires Gate MCP API credentials (API Key/Secret) to function; never requests secrets in chat.
- Strict permissions and usage rules to ensure data safety—read-only queries only, with no trading or transfers possible.
- Case-based intent routing for flexible user queries (total, per-coin, per-account, ledger/activity).
- Detailed account type mapping and fiat valuation handling for consistent outputs.
summary: Gate multi-account asset and balance query skill. Use when the user asks to check total assets, account balance, or specific coin holdings across all account...
